item.title: Awara Onsen: Fukui's Premier Hot Spring Resort Town — Guide
item.description: Awara Onsen is Fukui’s most prominent hot spring resort town, having welcomed guests for over 130 years since its waters were first developed in the late 19th century, and today offers numerous ryokan, public bathhouses and a relaxed resort atmosphere. Its convenient location near the coast makes it a natural base for winter Echizen crab trips and sightseeing at nearby Tojinbo Cliffs, and a foot bath in the town centre offers a free, casual way to sample the waters even for day visitors not staying overnight.
